anomalies.description: Vehicle loses control on snowy road, veers off roadway, and rolls over multiple times, resulting in complete loss of orientation and view obstruction by snow/debris.

Vehicle impacts a solid barrier or wall, causing massive dust/debris cloud, structural deformation visible (e.g., bent metal at f6–f7), and rapid loss of visibility; consistent with a high-speed crash.
Intense bright flash and rapidly expanding luminous cloud observed from f4 to f9, coinciding with the impact phase; suggests secondary explosion (e.g., fuel/air ignition) following initial collision.
A vehicle impacts a barrier or embankment, causing a violent spray of debris and dust, followed by loss of camera view (blackout at 38.0s), consistent with a crash.

Dashcam footage shows a vehicle ahead on a wet highway losing control and veering sharply left across lanes, indicating an imminent or ongoing crash; the scene remains stable but the maneuver is abnormal and dangerous.
A dark vehicle ahead on the highway suddenly swerves sharply to the right, loses control, and appears to collide with the right guardrail or embankment, kicking up debris and smoke/dust.
A dark pickup truck in the left lane loses control, swerves sharply right across the lane markings, and collides with the right guardrail or embankment, kicking up debris and smoke/dust.

The same pickup truck, now re-entering the roadway from the right shoulder, crosses into the left lane and collides head-on or near-head-on with an oncoming vehicle (visible as headlights and front structure), resulting in a visible impact flash/spark and violent displacement of the truck.
A dark sedan in the left lane loses traction on the snowy road, slides sideways, and collides with the rear-left side of a white sedan ahead in the same lane.
